nodes.name: Webhook: New Quote Request
nodes.notes: Called by the frontend form (see /frontend) with: { customer: {fullName, email, phone, companyName, billingAddress}, event: {date, time, deliveryLocation, deliveryMethod}, items: [{name, quantity}] }

parameters.query: SELECT id, name, unit_price, markup_percent FROM menu_items WHERE is_active = true;

nodes.name: Match Items & Flag Custom
nodes.notes: Normalises spelling/casing and does a simple fuzzy match. Anything below the similarity threshold is flagged is_custom = true instead of being rejected.

nodes.name: AI Estimate Cape Town Price (custom items)
nodes.notes: Calls an LLM (with web search / retrieval on your provider's side, e.g. Claude or GPT with browsing tools enabled) to estimate a fair Cape Town catering-market price for each unmatched item, plus a one-line reason. Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY in n8n's environment variables, not in this file.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO customers (full_name, email, phone_number, company_name, billing_address)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE SET full_name = EXCLUDED.full_name
RETURNING id;

nodes.name: Insert Quote Items
nodes.notes: Runs once per item (n8n executes a Postgres node once per input item automatically).

nodes.name: Insert Custom Item Requests
nodes.notes: Only fires for items where is_custom = true. Filter this branch with an IF node ahead of it if your n8n version needs it explicit.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO custom_item_requests (quote_id, quote_item_id, item_name, ai_estimated_price, ai_estimate_source, ai_estimate_confidence)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6);

parameters.subject: =Quote {{ $('Insert Quote').first().json.quote_number }} needs your price review

nodes.name: Generate PDF Quote
nodes.notes: Calls a lightweight HTML-to-PDF service (e.g. self-hosted gotenberg, or a service like pdfshift/api2pdf) rendering the /frontend/quote-template.html with this quote's data. Replaces AutoCrat.

parameters.subject: =Your ResLife Foods quote {{ $('Insert Quote').first().json.quote_number }}
parameters.text: Thanks for your order! Your quote is attached. It's valid for 14 days.

parameters.query:
UPDATE quotes SET status = 'sent', sent_at = now() WHERE id = $1;
INSERT INTO order_status_log (quote_id, status, note) VALUES ($1, 'sent', 'Auto-sent, no custom items required review.');

main.node: AI Estimate Cape Town Price (custom items)
